title: Normalized cochain computation data for localized strict tensor towers
statement: For a small site $\mathcal C$, a commutative ring sheaf $R$, and $V\in\mathcal C$, use its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], exact localized extension [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and flat-term K-flat representatives [def-pc-kflat-complex] and [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. A strict unital algebra tower is a functor $S:\mathbf N^{op}\to(R\downarrow\operatorname{CAlgSh})$, with underlying module tower obtained by scalar restriction. Use the existing strict reduction and termwise extension [def-sf-strict-tensor-reduction-termwise]. A reduction-family presentation consists of a functor $F:S\mapsto\mathcal R_S$, its universal left-derived counits for ordinary strict tensor reduction, invertible on every flat-term K-flat representative, and their coefficient-map naturality equations. Define the normalized ordinary localized comparison by $[p]_a\otimes s\mapsto[p\otimes s]_a$ and define its derived normalization by the equation conjugating its degreewise localized chain map by those counits and exact-extension localization comparisons. Define coefficient-linear evaluation presentations using the existing cochain scalar-extension model [def-sfb-derived-change-of-rings-cochain-model] and exact scalar restriction [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]: the ordinary identification takes $p\otimes s$ to $s\otimes p$, and the derived identification obeys its computation-counit equation on every flat-term K-flat representative. All pure tensors and extension summands are the actual presheaf tensors followed by the canonical sheafification units. These records describe presentations only; existence and the localized comparison are not asserted by this definition.
